jobs.title: Revenue Management Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

 Revenue Analyst

 Manages rooms and function space inventory to ensure inventory is allocated and restricted properly to maximize revenue and profits for hotels in the market. Responsible for building rates, packages and hotel sales strategy information in the hotel(s)’ inventory systems. The position makes pricing and positioning recommendations for market hotels. Conducts analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory, and Food and Beverage revenues. Position contributes to forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections. Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities.

 The Ideal candidate must have:

 Min. 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.,

 OR

 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting, Hospitality Management or related major.

 Experience in all of Marriott Systems – Oyv2, Marsha, Opera, CITY, RPO, PRP, Revenue Planning is preferred but not mandatory.

 Strong process driven mindset with experience in system integration and support.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data, develop forecasts, identify key business trends, and create automated tools and reports to improve accuracy and decision-making.

 Ability to communicate in English with guest, management and employees to their understanding. Analyzes competitive sets, price positioning, seasonality, mix and displacement on a continuous basis.

 Assists hotel with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

 Analyzes month end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.

 General knowledge and understanding of major functions of the Revenue Management, Reservations, Sales & Marketing and Finance Departments.

 Computer literate with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, data analysis, macros/VBA, and the ability to develop automated forecasting and analytical tools.

 Experience with ADP and PeopleSoft is preferred.

 Data coding experience is preferred.

 Assist in the management of rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue, as well as maintain accuracy of information and enhance automation efforts in reservation system. Assist in the preparation of competitive analysis and other supporting documents for presentation at market sales strategy meetings. Assist in managing room authorizations, rates, and restrictions, including communicating rate restrictions and strategy to properties. Perform all Revenue Management month end reporting and auditing and provide forward looking information for the purposes of forecasting, targeting need areas and balancing financial expectations. Accurately generate, process and update all property and market Revenue Management reports and serve as primary source for majority of reporting and analytical needs of the Revenue Management team. Assist with system maintenance including but not limited to, inputting rate hurdles, monitoring forecasted demand, updating group forecasting and running daily system checks. Assist with training of new associates as necessary on revenue management tools. Assist in the implementation of hotel sales strategies in the reservation and inventory systems.

 Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats; move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 35 pounds without assistance; stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

 At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

 Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

 The Pricing applied science team has critical impacts on the business health. The team is building a scalable and robust system to enable pricing as a lever to optimize business performance. The system should be steered based on desired outputs, such as a given tradeoff between volume and profit. Our work directly decides prices across different lines of business, influencing multi-billion dollar revenue.

 As a Senior Manager of Applied Science, you will lead a team and collaborate with a strong team of strategists, engineers, product managers, operations and analytics. You will be deeply involved in the technical details of building applied science solutions to optimize business performance. As a leader in Applied Science, you will set best practices, architect solutions, design processes and manage a highly skilled team that continues to grow. You will also contribute to an area of active research: causal inference using machine learning methods, stochastic optimization, ML-based demand estimation, experiment design and analysis.

 In this role, you will:

 • Manage a team of applied scientists to deliver scalable and robust machine learning and data science solutions to pricing and monetization with engineering rigor.

 • Architect solutions, review models and provide necessary technical guidance.

 • Dissect business problems into digestible solutions.

 • Follow company strategic directions and align with stakeholders on goals and roadmaps.

 • Set the team vision, design roadmap and manage the execution to deliver outstanding results.

 • Hire, mentor and grow the team.

 • Collaborate with other applied science, analytics and data engineering teams to build a great data culture in EG.

 • 8+ years of related industry experience

 • Passion for management and creating opportunities for career growth for team members

 • Experience in working with pricing models

 • Experience with large scale marketplace experiment design and analysis

 • Understanding of modern machine learning and data science techniques and their mathematical underpinning

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Deal Desk
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.



Deepgram is hiring a Senior Manager, Deal Desk to build our deal desk from the ground up and run it. Deepgram is a usage-based voice AI platform (speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the Voice Agent API), sold through self-serve plans, enterprise commitments and cloud marketplaces. You'll report to the Chief Accounting Officer and work daily with leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance.



The desk is not a control function. Its job is to help Sales win better deals faster, at prices we can defend.



What you'll do

 - Build the desk: approval matrix, pre-approved playbook, and credit and promo guidelines, so most deals need no approval.

 - Run it day to day: review non-standard deals and give same-day answers.

 - Shape large deals early: commitment size, ramps, product mix and terms.

 - Partner with Product and sales leadership on pricing and packaging.

 - Build pricing insight: deal margin, realized discount, and win rate by discount band.

 - Keep deals clean and audit-ready, with approvals and terms recorded in Salesforce.

 - Use AI to run the desk: an agent does the first-pass review; you make the call and improve the rules.

 - Build out CPQ in Salesforce so the playbook and approvals live in the quote.

 - Partner with Customer Success on renewals at first, then take ownership of renewals as the desk matures.



What you'll need

 - 6+ years in deal desk, deal strategy or pricing at a B2B technology company, with 3+ running a desk.

 - Usage-based pricing experience: commitments, credits, overage, ramps and rollover.

 - A desk, matrix or playbook you built that sales adopted.

 - Financial fluency, including how deal terms affect revenue recognition.

 - Hands-on experience building Salesforce CPQ, plus SQL.

 - Credibility with sales executives, clear writing, and an AI-native way of working you can show.



Nice to have

 - Infrastructure, API or AI company experience.

 - Pre-IPO experience.

 - Cloud marketplace private offers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

 - Has owned or run renewals.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. This role brings together commercial strategy, business intelligence, demand planning, and bid management in one function. Working as a strategic partner and deputy to the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, the Bid Director owns the full pursuit lifecycle, from market strategy and pre-tender capture through bid submission and handover to delivery. We're looking for a strategist who is equally strong commercially, technically, and financially, and who leads people and cross-functional teams with confidence.

 Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.

 Responsibilities:

 Commercial Strategy, Business Intelligence, and Demand Planning

• Shape the commercial strategy with the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, including target markets, regions of focus, and growth priorities.

• Lead the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager across planning, pricing policy, business intelligence, and demand planning.

• Build business and bid intelligence (market, customer, competitor, and procurement insight) that drives strategy, pipeline, and pursuit decisions.

• Own demand planning and pipeline forecasting, aligning bid capacity and resources with expected opportunities and revenue targets.

 Pre-Tender, Capture, and Bid/No-Bid

• Own a gated process that all pre-tender pursuits follow, aligned with commercial strategy and target regions.

• Deliver capture plans for strategic and specific pursuits, shaping opportunities well before tender release.

• Own bid/no-bid recommendations, presenting a clear view of strategic fit, path to win, risk, and financial return to senior leadership.

 Bid Strategy and Execution

• Frame each bid to win: set win themes, value proposition, competitive discriminators, and pricing position at kickoff.

• Shape solutions and commercial offers with Operations, Technical, Finance, and Legal so they are competitive, deliverable, and profitable.

• Build and challenge bid financial models, pricing, and business cases, ensuring every bid meets agreed margin thresholds.

• Embed disciplined bid planning, with clear milestones, review gates, owners, and deadlines.

 Leadership and Partnership

• Lead and develop a team of Bid Managers, Bid Specialists, Bid Coordinators, and the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager as one high-performing function.

• Direct cross-functional bid teams with authority and hold contributors accountable to deadlines.

• Make timely, confident decisions under ambiguity and balance risk against win potential.

• Connect sales, bids, contracts, and delivery, so what we sell is what we can deliver profitably.

 Experience:

• 12+ years in bid, capture, commercial, or business development roles, including 5+ years leading teams at a senior manager, director level, or equivalent.

• Commercially and sales-savvy: a track record of winning large, complex tenders and a strong understanding of sales cycles, customer relationships, and market positioning.

• Strategic: able to frame opportunities, set bid strategy, and make clear recommendations to executives.

• Technically proficient: able to understand and shape technical and operational solutions, engage credibly with SMEs, and turn requirements into compelling, deliverable offers. Comfortable working with data, BI, and planning tools.

• Financially strong: skilled in financial modeling, pricing, P&L, cash flow, and margin management, and able to defend bid financials with Finance and executive leadership.

• A confident leader: builds high-performing teams and influences senior stakeholders across functions.

• Professional fluency in French and English , written and spoken (proficiency in a third language is a bonus). English is required to work with Lyft teams, customers, and partners across North America and internationally.

• Preferred: APMP or Shipley experience, multi-region bidding, and a background spanning bid and delivery.

 Benefits:

• Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Pet benefits

• Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account

• RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Security Pricing and Packaging (Serverless) - Security Solutions
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role

 We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless.

 More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence.

 We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call.

 The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does.

 What You Will Be Doing

•
 Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team.

•
 Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships.

•
 Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue.

•
 Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy.

•
 Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it.

•
 Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities.

•
 Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit.

•
 You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one.

 What You Bring

•
 You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex.

•
 Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side.

•
 You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator.

•
 You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design.

•
 You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes.

•
 You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager I, Base Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.

 Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.

 The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.

 The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.

 Responsibilities:

 As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:

• Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)

• Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions

• Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices

• Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio

• Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams

• Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles

• Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.

• Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.

 Experience:

• 5+ years of product management or relevant experience, with significant time spent on algorithmic, data-driven, pricing, or marketplace products

• A deep technical understanding of microeconomics, and ideally a background in Operations Research, Econometrics, Machine Learning, or algorithmic systems

• Experience owning pricing, revenue management, or other economic levers with direct P&L impact; experience with price optimization, elasticity modeling, or cost modeling is a strong plus

• Experience running A/B tests and market-level experiments, using statistical and causal inference techniques to evaluate results, and developing post-launch testing strategies

• Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design

• Ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products, and excellent judgment about the dynamics of a product ecosystem

• Natural ability to make things happen around you; you manage ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies across many teams in an organized and structured way

• Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level — within teams, within the company, and with executives

• Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation

 Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary

jobs.title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 




YOUR ROLE

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Product Vision & Strategy

 - Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

 - Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

 - Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

 - Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

 - Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

 - Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

 - Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

Impact & Influence

 - Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

 - Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.




YOUR PROFILE

 - 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

 - A track record of making complex systems radically simple

 - Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

 - Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

 - Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

 - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

jobs.title: Director, Pricing & Packaging
jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

 Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

 By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

 WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

 Box is evolving in terms of pricing and packaging – taking our more straightforward, seat-based model and augmenting it with API-call-base and AI-driven consumption. The Director, Pricing & Packaging will help Box navigate the shift from traditional enterprise software pricing towards consumption-based pricing tied to AI usage, units, platform activity, costs, and business value.

 The impact of this leader will be both strategic and operational. They will bring analytical rigor to pricing model design while helping cross-functional teams align around recommendations, tradeoffs, and implementation. Success will depend not only on building the right model, but also on clearly articulating the business context and strategy behind pricing recommendations to senior leaders.

 This is an individual contributor role reporting into our Vice President, Product Marketing. This role will be hybrid based in our Redwood City, CA global HQ three days per week.

 YOUR IMPACT AT BOX

 The Director, Pricing & Packaging will own a strategic and execution-oriented pricing function focused on helping Box modernize its pricing approach. Key responsibilities include:

•
 Lead the evolution of Box’s pricing model from a primarily seat-based approach to more complex platform, usage, and AI consumption-based models.

•
 Develop pricing models for AI usage and consumption units that make sense for Box’s business as the traditional seat-unit model becomes less central.

•
 Partner closely with key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Controllership, GTM, and executive leadership to roll out pricing models that are analytically sound and commercially viable.

•
 Build rigorous pricing analyses using strong quantitative skills, including modeling, spreadsheets, regression, intake analysis, cost considerations, and business-case development.

•
 Translate complex pricing work into a clear business story that helps executives and partner teams understand the recommendation, rationale, tradeoffs, and expected impact.

•
 Operate effectively in ambiguity, bringing structure to complex, evolving problems where the path forward may not yet be fully defined.

•
 Drive alignment and implementation, not just strategy, by working through operational challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and bringing stakeholders along.

•
 Understand and articulate how AI models are priced, why those pricing structures matter, and how they affect Box’s business economics.

 WHO YOU ARE

 Box executives are engaged, passionate leaders who prioritize customer centricity, innovation, and growth. As an AI-first company, XLT members bring a growth mindset and proactively leverage AI to make faster, smarter decisions that amplify their impact across the business.

 As a leader in this role, you have/are:

•
 Highly quantitative skill set, including comfort with pricing modeling, spreadsheets, regression, cost analysis, and structured business analysis.

•
 Strong pricing and packaging expertise, ideally in enterprise SaaS, AI, platform pricing, or usage-based pricing environments.

•
 Strong understanding of AI-related pricing dynamics, including how AI models are priced, why those pricing structures matter, and how they affect business economics.

•
 Ability to do the analytical work directly, not only manage or advise on it.

•
 Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate pricing recommendations clearly to executives and cross-functional partners.

•
 Influence and stakeholder-management skills, especially in ambiguous situations where teams may have competing priorities or resistance to change.

•
 Ability to operationalize strategy, ensuring recommendations move beyond a deck

 Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

 About the team

 Revenue Operations is a small team with outsized reach. Deal Desk is the part of RevOps closest to the deal: we help reps structure pricing, build quotes, and move contracts through approval so they can close faster without giving away margin. As Alloy sells into more banks, credit unions, fintechs, and channel partners, more deals come through the desk every quarter, and they're getting more varied. This role reports to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Deal Desk, and will be the second person on the desk.

 Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

 What you'll be doing

 You'll be the first stop for reps working through the mechanics of a deal: building and checking quotes, keeping the approval queue moving, and making sure what gets signed is what gets booked and billed. It's a high-volume, detail-heavy seat with a front-row view of how Alloy prices, packages, and contracts, and a lot of room to make the process better as you learn it.

• Build and review quotes from Salesforce CPQ all the way through the Ironclad workflow process, checking that products, pricing, terms, and opportunity setup (new business, renewal, amendment, upsell, channel) are correct before they move forward.

• Work the twice-daily Ironclad approval queue alongside Legal and Accounting, reviewing order forms against our standard terms and Deal Desk Levers and flagging anything non-standard.

• Support the triage of incoming requests in Deal Desk, Ironclad, and the Rev Ops Help queues, confirm each one has the context needed for review, and route it to the right person.

• Manage first-pass pricing using our pricing calculator and guidelines, so senior Deal Desk time goes to large and novel deals.

• Partner with our Systems and Salesforce admins to improve CPQ and quoting workflows: flag where reps get stuck, document requirements for fixes and enhancements, test changes before they go live, and update guides once they ship.

• Review closed-won contracts for booking accuracy (ACV, CARR, term, billing frequency, uplifts) and keep the bookings tracker current.

• Pull weekly reporting on deals in flight, request volume, turnaround time, and discount and approval trends.

• Help maintain CPQ, Ironclad, and Deal Desk process, and turn repeat questions into documentation (CPQ Handbook)

 Who we’re looking for

 Must-haves:

• 1-3 years in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Order Management, or a similar analytical role supporting a sales team.

• Hands on Salesforce experience with opportunities, quotes, and reports.

• Salesforce CPQ (or similar) experience.

• Interest in automating manual deal desk work.

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

• Sharp attention to detail, with a habit of catching the wrong date or mismatched number before it reaches a customer.

• Comfort working a queue: many requests at once, prioritized by deadline, with people kept informed along the way.

• Clear, direct written communication, including explaining a policy to a rep or saying "not yet" without creating friction.

• Curiosity about how deals work, from pricing and contract terms to how they flow into bookings and billing.

 Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle management tool.

• Experience gathering requirements or testing changes for a CRM or quoting tool.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services.

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics and deal terms such as ARR, CARR, usage-based pricing, ramps, and multi-year uplifts.

• Exposure to order forms, billing, or revenue recognition basics (ASC 606).

• Familiarity with SQL.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

 Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

The engine is live and evolving, and thousands of pricing decisions run through it every day, across everything we sell, owned and partner-operated alike.

 The foundation is built; the opportunity is what we build on top of it: Fever intends to be the leading platform for pricing concerts, exhibitions, live sports, game centres, theme parks and whatever comes next.

 Navan is seeking a Sr. Analyst of Deal Strategy to collaborate closely with our sales team in driving deal negotiations. This role is responsible for managing contract negotiations, aligning customer needs with Navan's strategic priorities, and partnering with internal sales and business teams throughout the contract signing process and various internal operational projects.

 What You’ll Do:

• Develop in-depth knowledge of Navan licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our sales teams

• Partner with the sales team to find a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to Navan selling policies

• Be a critical enabler of deal formation and execution, focusing on minimizing sales cycle times while optimizing revenue, profitability, and market share based on business priorities

• Actively negotiate deals directly with the customer as needed

• Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, contracts, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management

• Drive best practices to increase sales efficiency and effectiveness via deal reviews, early checkpoint and enforcement of standard business practices and policies

• Assist with non-standard deal requests, structuring sophisticated deals, driving cross-functional and cross solution teamwork and ensure revenue recognition requirements are handled

• Support metrics and processes to improve business visibility and consistency of practices across geographies

• Overseeing deal financials, pricing, business risk, and revenue recognition implication

 What We’re Looking For:

• Business degree and/or JD

• 3+ years of software industry experience, (Deal Desk, Finance, Sales Operations experience preferred)

• Customer facing experience preferred

• Strong eye for business and proven track record in commercial negotiations

• Self-motivated and able to work under pressure; diligent with deliverables and deadlines, able to multitask

• Solid understanding of software revenue recognition principles

• Basic understanding of commercial law

• Experience in contract management

• Excellent interpersonal skills – verbal and written

• Strong analytical skills along with the ability to demonstrate practical judgment in sophisticated situations

• Great leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact regularly with senior management

• Proficient knowledge of Salesforce, CPQ

jobs.title: Revenue Analyst - Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Revenue Analyst , you’re not just analyzing data to help maximize hotel revenue – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

 • Manage revenue data: Collect, enter, process, and maintain historical and statistical data to support hotel revenue management
• Generate and distribute reports: Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly reports using data management systems
• Analyze market trends: Evaluate demand, pricing, and market conditions to identify revenue opportunities
• Conduct competitive research: Perform and document shop calls to assess industry trends and competitor pricing
• Provide administrative and guest support: Assist with inquiries and administrative tasks to ensure smooth operations

 What It Takes to Make the Stay

 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Monetization and Contract Success (MACS) Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 The Finance Operations (FinOps) team is Stripe’s global backbone, dedicated to delivering and continuously improving essential business services—billing and collections, procurement, monetization, payroll, and travel and expenses. We drive company value through data-driven insights, operational rigor, and a relentless focus on excellence. As strategic partners, we shape business decisions, champion technology-enabled solutions, own operational strategy, and collaborate across global functions to enable Stripe’s growth.

 The Monetization and Contract Success (MACS) team sits within Monetization Services and helps Stripe execute complex commercial agreements efficiently and accurately. The team partners across the deal and contract lifecycle to reduce friction, improve deal velocity, support scalable commercial constructs, and deliver a seamless user experience after contract execution.

 What you’ll do

 We’re looking for a Monetization and Contract Success (MACS) Specialist to join our growing team. In this high-impact role, you will guide complex commercial agreements through pre-signature review from a supportability lens - helping ensure that contractual terms are clear, operationally feasible, and can be accurately implemented in Stripe’s systems. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to resolve issues, strengthen controls, improve workflows, and develop scalable solutions that increase deal-cycle efficiency and reduce downstream user friction.

 Responsibilities

• Serve as a subject-matter expert across the commercial contract lifecycle, answering questions and advising deal owners on the supportability elements of sales contract reviews

• Review and interpret commercial and legal terms, identify operational requirements and potential risks, and prepare agreements or deal inputs for review under established guidelines.

• Partner with Deal Pricing, Deal Strategy, Commercial Legal, Business Practices, Accounting, Billing, Tax, Sales Operations, Engineering, and account teams to align commercial objectives with operational capabilities.

• Review and, where appropriate, advise on commercial terms, balancing user needs, Stripe’s objectives, operational feasibility, and risk.

• Own the feedback loop with Pricing Activation for accurate and timely onboarding of custom contracts and pricing terms into Stripe’s billing and financial systems.

• Manage contract and deal workflows in relevant systems, maintain clear documentation, and provide proactive communication on status, dependencies, and next steps.

• Support the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including inquiries, escalations, implementation troubleshooting, billing-related issues, and post-execution corrections.

• Build scalable, auditable processes and controls that balance and improve contract quality, activation accuracy, deal velocity, and the user experience.

• Analyze operational data and recurring issues to identify root causes, measure performance, and recommend process or system improvements.

• Partner with Engineering and internal systems teams to translate operational needs into durable tooling, automation, and workflow enhancements.

• Support internal and external audits, key programs, and other cross-functional initiatives as needed.

• Contribute to building a high-performing team culture grounded in sound judgment, continuous improvement, accountability, and excellent stakeholder service.

 Who you are

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial contracting, deal management, legal operations, monetization operations, pricing activation, billing operations, or a related field.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret commercial and legal language and translate complex contract terms into clear operational and system requirements.

• Experience reviewing commercial agreements and partnering effectively with Legal or other risk and control functions; experience supporting commercial negotiations is strongly valued.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources, investigate complex issues, and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.

jobs.title: Director, Upscale Revenue Management
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

 The Director, Revenue Management - Upscale Brands plays a pivotal role in overseeing and optimizing revenue-related functions across the Upscale segment and ChoiceROCS Program. The purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and manage the activities related to Upscale Brands business readiness, property performance, education, and adoption across ChoiceROCS. This role leads a team of two Regional Managers, who in turn lead a team of approximately 20 Revenue Managers across the Upscale Brands portfolio, and is responsible for driving hotel performance while ensuring the team are set up to effectively support our franchisees and their commercial revenue success.

 Note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

 • Team Leadership & Development: Lead and manage a team of revenue optimization professionals, ensuring effective communication, goal setting, and performance management. Provide training and guidance to the two direct-report Regional Managers and their teams of Revenue Managers to enhance their skills and capabilities in revenue management practices.
• Change Management: Develop effective and appropriate change interventions and deliverables in conjunction with the segment and program team, including communication plans, training and engagement materials, resource and training needs analysis.
• Service Optimization: Collaborate with Commercial and other stakeholders across the business (Global Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Operations) to enhance service delivery, pricing strategies, and customer experience in ways that drive revenue growth. Drive stakeholder engagement and management to support project and program delivery, and support stakeholders in adopting new changes.
• Process Improvement & Business Readiness: Implement and refine revenue optimization processes, systems, and policies to increase efficiency, streamline operations, and maximize profitability. Ensure all Upscale Brands ChoiceROCS colleagues are ready to use, support, adopt, and exploit new technology and processes from release through to evolution.
• Performance Metrics: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to track and evaluate the success of revenue management strategies, providing regular reports to department leaders. Monitor the portfolio and identify gaps in achieving targets and Commercial Plan goals, creating action plans to support eliminating the gaps.
• Franchisee Focus: Maintain a customer-centric approach in revenue strategies, ensuring revenue initiatives align with franchisee needs and expectations. Support Prominent Clients and Choice partners and manage escalation requests.

 QUALIFICATIONS:

 Employment Experience

 • Proven experience in driving revenue growth while maintaining a focus on operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
• Experience in developing and leading a team of professionals.
• Experience in delivering organizational change involving changes to people, processes, technology, structure, behavior, and new ways of working.
• Experience in stakeholder management with a diverse range of stakeholders, overcoming resistance to change and demonstrating the ability to gain trust and understand the issues that matter to people most.
• Proven experience in navigating complex business landscapes within a matrix organization.
• Considerable knowledge of the change management challenges associated with implementing continuous change in a fast-moving organization.
• 5+ years of progressive leadership experience.

 Technical Skills

 • Advanced use of Microsoft tools including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

 Additional Skills & Competencies

 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Detail oriented.
• Ability to travel (15% of the time).

 Education Requirements

 • 4-Year Degree Required or equivalent experience.

 Salary Range

 The salary range for this position is $163,544 -$ 192,405. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

 Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

 • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
• Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
• Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
• Employee recognition programs
• Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

 Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. jobs.title: Cluster Reservations and Revenue Optimization Manager
jobs.description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Cluster Reservations and Revenue Optimization Manager , you’re not just driving profitability through strategic pricing and inventory – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

 Revenue and Commercial Performance

 • Work alongside RMCC and the Cluster Commercial Director on forecasts, budgets, demand calendars, pricing recommendations and commercial action plans for each hotel.
• Monitor occupancy, average daily rate, RevPAR, pickup, booking pace, cancellations, no-shows, channel mix, and competitor activity; flag risks and opportunities promptly.
• Support rate and inventory strategies by room type, segment, length of stay, booking window, and distribution channel within approved authority.
• Analyze group and corporate inquiries, displacement, special events, and need periods; recommend commercially sound decisions.
• Review performance of direct, brand, online travel agency, wholesale, and other channels; identify opportunities to improve net revenue and reduce distribution cost.

 Reservations Operations

• Oversee accurate and timely handling of individual, group, and special reservation requests by phone, email, and approved systems.
• Maintain correct rates, packages, restrictions, allotments, room descriptions, policies, and inventory across the property management system, central reservation system, and connected channels.
• Ensure deposits, guarantees, modifications, cancellations, billing instructions, and guest preferences are captured and communicated accurately.
• Coordinate with Front Office, Sales, Events, Finance, and other departments to manage arrivals, overbookings, room blocks, VIP needs, and service recovery.
• Monitor response time, call quality, booking conversion, data accuracy, and unresolved guest or partner cases; implement improvements.

 Controls and Reporting

• Produce reliable daily, weekly, and monthly reservation and revenue reports, with clear explanations of material variances.
• Maintain rate integrity, approved access rights, audit trails, payment data handling, and compliance with Hilton standards, property procedures, and applicable privacy requirements.
• Check system interfaces and booking flows; coordinate resolution of mapping, parity, availability, and connectivity issues with relevant teams.
• Document procedures, train colleagues on system changes, and support contingency plans during outages or peak demand.

 People Leadership

• Plan staffing and schedules across the cluster according to demand and service requirements.

jobs.description:
Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 The Finance Operations (FinOps) team is Stripe’s global backbone, dedicated to delivering and continuously improving essential business services - billing and collections, procurement, monetization, payroll, and travel and expenses. We drive company value through data-driven insights, operational rigor, and a relentless focus on excellence. As strategic partners, we shape business decisions, champion technology-enabled solutions, own operational strategy, and collaborate across global functions to enable Stripe’s growth.

 What you’ll do

 We're looking for a Monetization Services Specialist - Pricing Activation to join our growing team. This individual will help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts, workflows and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

 Responsibilities

• Own accurate and timely activation of sold custom pricing contracts.

• Own the pricing activation of custom pricing contracts in Stripe’s billing systems, from intake and requirements validation through configuration and post-activation checks.

• Translate legal terms including approved pricing, product, invoicing, and effective-date terms into accurate billing configurations; identify and escalate ambiguous or conflicting terms.

• Perform quality-control and reconciliation checks to confirm that configurations produce the expected billing outcomes.

• Partner with internal systems, deal desk, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineer and account managers to develop and improve operational processes and programs

• Partner with sales to investigate and resolve user inquiries related to onboarding and rate discrepancy issues

• Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience

• Work closely with other Stripe teams to assist with system implementations for billings, collections, and assist with internal and external ad-hoc audit support

• Help scale and optimize our processes by assisting with the execution of key projects and programs.

• Gain unique insights into how businesses of varying sizes and industries operate and scale on Stripe

• Can quickly learn the Stripe ways of working and make a real impact through process enhancements.

• Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe

• Contribute to or act as DRI for with monthly and quarterly flux analysis of key metrics

• Contribute to or act as DRI for ad hoc projects

 Who you are

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 4-5 years of relevant financial operations/pricing activation experience or 4+ years of strong customer service experience with a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Tech, or relevant field

• Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal

• Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions

• Strong knowledge of gSuite tools, Salesforce, and MS-Office products and experience working with/analyzing contracts and large data sets

• Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case

• Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders

• Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results

• Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices

• Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive and detail oriented

• The ability to be flexible and adapt quickly with changing requirements

 Preferred qualifications

• Familiarity with payments, fintech, SaaS, or other transaction-based business models

• A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom

• Enthusiasm for building scalable systems and solving operational problems through process improvements and automation

• Experience with SQL/data-analysis tools

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, GTM Strategy & Sales Packaging
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft Ads gives brands a unique way to reach consumers during high-intent moments: on their way to concerts, games, nights out, and everyday destinations. In this role, you'll set the strategy behind how we bring those moments to market, arm our sellers to win, and connect advertisers with millions of riders across the country.

 Lyft Ads is looking for a Senior Manager of Sales Packaging & Go-to-Market Strategy to build and lead the function that turns ridership data, cultural moments, and product capabilities into the packages our sales team sells every day. This is a strategic leadership role: you'll set the packaging and pricing agenda for the full Lyft Ads portfolio, build the go-to-market motions behind our biggest revenue moments, and give sellers the stories, structure, and pricing tools they need to win.

 You are a builder. You operate comfortably at the intersection of strategy and execution, and you have a track record of driving commercial outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You bring a POV to partnership and packaging conversations, and you know how to align internal and external stakeholders around a shared vision. You are energized by the challenge of taking a scaled, high-growth advertising business and making it even better: more differentiated, more efficient, and more impactful for the brands and agencies that invest with Lyft Ads.

 You'll operate at the intersection of data, product, pricing, creative, and sales, and you'll be expected to bring an independent point of view on where Lyft Ads should show up, what we should charge, and how we package multi-product solutions with measurement built in. This role owns and manages the Lyft Ads Studio team, sits at the table with Sales leadership, and works in close partnership with Data Science, Finance, Product Marketing, Product, and cross-functional leadership across the business.

 Responsibilities:

• Own the sales packaging strategy for Lyft Ads' full suite of on- and off-platform advertising solutions, building differentiated packages that map to advertiser objectives and buying behavior

• Set the vision and calendar for tentpole and cultural-moment packaging (Super Bowl, March Madness, Women’s World Cup, Coachella, Formula 1, SXSW, Halloween, Valentine's Day, New Year's Eve), using ridership and audience data to identify where and when advertisers should show up

• Craft the go-to-market narratives behind each package, from initial data-driven thesis to the story sellers use in market, in partnership with Product Marketing and Lyft Ads Studio

• Formulate pricing and deal economics for sponsorships, tentpole packages, and multi-product bundles, balancing revenue optimization with competitive positioning and advertiser value

• Build multi-product solutions that combine packaging with measurement frameworks, giving advertisers a clear read on performance and giving sellers proof points to close

• Partner with Sales, Data Science, and Finance to model package performance, set pricing guardrails, and build scalable frameworks for both direct IO and programmatic deal structures

• Develop audience-segmented packaging for key verticals (CPG, QSR, Auto, Financial Services, Travel) to sharpen sales conversations by category

• Own the GTM materials that arm the field: one-sheets, rate cards, media plans, packaging guides, and sales playbooks

• Establish a feedback loop between field sales and the packaging/pricing function so offerings stay relevant, competitive, and commercially viable

• Report on tentpole and package performance and build case studies with Product Marketing to prove out the model and inform the next cycle

• Represent packaging strategy in front of Sales and Ads leadership, and act as a thought partner to the VP on where the portfolio should go next

• Lead and manage the Lyft Ads Studio team, currently two creative strategists, a designer, and a program manager, setting priorities, workflow, and quality bar for the creative and GTM work that supports every package

• Hold a seat at the table with Sales leadership, representing packaging, pricing, and creative strategy in planning and pipeline conversations

• Build and maintain close working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Product, Data Science, Finance, and Marketing to keep packaging strategy aligned to the broader business

 Experience:

• 15+ years of experience in digital advertising, with meaningful depth in brand media solutions, programmatic, ad tech, and/or commerce/retail media

• In-depth understanding of building brand solutions across on-platform, programmatic, and experiential

• Strong knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP), SSPs, DMPs, CDPs, clean rooms, and measurement partners

• Experience

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, Finance, and Systems teams to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business.

To thrive in this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Pricing Operations Lead to help translate pricing and packaging decisions into clear, scalable execution. You will work closely with pricing leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM to ensure pricing changes are implemented accurately, system requirements are well managed, and launch decisions move from strategy to reality with discipline.

You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of business judgment, systems thinking, and program management. This role will help shape the operating backbone for pricing implementation, support teams developing billing and related monetization systems, and ensure the pricing team's needs are represented clearly in cross-functional planning and execution.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead the operational execution of pricing and packaging decisions from approval through implementation and launch

 - Translate pricing strategy, policies, and launch decisions into clear business requirements for billing, quoting, revenue, and related systems teams

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM teams to manage dependencies, scope tradeoffs, testing needs, and launch readiness

 - Own pricing-related requirement intake and prioritization on behalf of the pricing team, ensuring requests are clear, well managed, and tied to business needs

 - Support the design and implementation of new product, SKU, packaging, and billing configurations as pricing changes move into production

 - Establish lightweight but effective pricing operations processes, including governance, documentation, sign-offs, and issue tracking

 - Identify recurring friction in pricing execution and drive improvements that reduce ambiguity, delays, and rework

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 6+ years of experience leading pricing operations or closely related monetization, commercialization, or revenue operations work

 - Have a strong track record of helping implement complex pricing or packaging decisions across cross-functional teams

 - Can translate pricing intent into practical system requirements, launch plans, operating workflows, and stakeholder decisions

 - Have experience partnering closely with billing systems, product, engineering, finance, and go-to-market teams

 - Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and timelines at once

 - Communicate clearly with both business and technical audiences, and can drive accountability without creating unnecessary process

 - Care deeply about operational precision, customer clarity, and building systems that scale as pricing complexity grows

 - Are a self-starter who can roll up your sleeves and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Algorithms - Dynamic Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 The Marketplace team at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while simultaneously delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection is an integral part of that. Our team is the dynamic pricing team responsible for leveraging both real-time and historical data to set prices for every single ride at Lyft while balancing prices and ETAs to better serve our riders’ needs.

 We are looking for fast learning, data-driven individuals who are passionate about tackling these open-ended problems in pricing theory and making a large, positive impact in the business. In this role, you will work closely with Product and Engineering on a cross-functional team to prototype and build end-to-end dynamic pricing models that can operate at scale. In addition, you will be expected to leverage your domain knowledge and influence existing and future roadmaps to help Lyft continue to deliver a better experience for riders and drivers.

 Responsibilities:

• Partner with other scientists, colleagues in the pricing team, and with external teams to formalize problems mathematically and within the business context

• Perform complex data analysis to gain a deeper understanding of problems by identifying their root causes

• Develop and fit statistical, machine learning, or optimization models

• Write production code; collaborate with Software Engineers to ship models to production

• Design and implement both simulated and live experiments

• Analyze experimental and observational data; facilitate launch decisions

• Communicate findings to a broad audience consisting of Product, Engineering, and executive leadership

 Experience:

• Data Scientist with experience in Machine Learning, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative fields

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields

• 1-4+ years of professional experience for PhDs or 3-5+ years for Master’s in a Data Science role

• Passion for solving unstructured and non-standard mathematical problems

• End-to-end experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization

• Proficiency with Python, or another interpreted programming language like R or Matlab

• Proficiency in SQL - able to write structured and efficient queries involving multiple large data sets

• Ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem

• Strong oral and written communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners

• Experience in causal inference, LTV modeling, econometrics, or user choice modeling preferred

 Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

 Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

 Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location.
