jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Credit & Pricing
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Product Team

 The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

 As a Staff Product Manager on Affirm’s Credit & Pricing team, you’ll shape how consumers discover, understand, and use available credit. You’ll own the strategy for credit experiences spanning shopping, repayment, and marketing, turning complex credit capabilities into intuitive products that build trust and drive activation, conversion, and repeat engagement.

 What You'll Do

• Set the product direction. Define a cohesive vision for consumer credit experiences, identify the most valuable problems to solve, and translate your strategy into priorities across multiple teams.

• Build experiences that make credit understandable. Help consumers explore potential financing options before checkout, discover where they have purchasing power, and understand when credit becomes available again after repayment.

• Create more relevant consumer journeys. Develop personalized experiences for new and returning consumers, using research and experimentation to determine what information, guidance, and next steps best meet their needs.

• Connect platform capabilities to consumer outcomes. Own merchant prequalification and purchasing power experiences, partnering with core purchasing power and credit decisioning teams to translate underlying capabilities into clear, consistent experiences.

• Lead consequential product decisions. Bring Engineering, Design, Analytics, Credit, Marketing, Commercial, and Legal partners together to resolve tradeoffs across consumer needs, growth, risk, and partner commitments. Influence senior leaders through clear recommendations and sound judgment.

• Own measurable results. Define success, lead discovery and experimentation, and use funnel analysis and consumer feedback to improve activation, purchase conversion, repeat engagement, and comprehension while supporting responsible access to credit.

 What We Look For

• A record of building impactful consumer products. 7+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated success taking products from discovery through launch and scaling adoption in fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, or similarly complex environments.

• Leadership across teams. Experience independently setting direction for a substantial product area, influencing senior stakeholders, and aligning multiple teams around priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Strong consumer product judgment. An ability to translate complex systems into intuitive experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, clear communication, and consumer trust.

• Strategic and technical depth. You connect long-term opportunities to practical product and platform decisions, and work effectively with engineers on capabilities that serve multiple experiences.

• Analytical and experimental rigor. You combine customer research, behavioral data, and well-designed experiments to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and decide what to scale, change, or stop.

• Ownership in ambiguity. You bring structure to open-ended problems, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate the rationale, risks, and support needed to move forward.

• Relevant domain curiosity. Experience with credit, lending, personalization, or AI-powered consumer experiences is a plus. You can learn complex domains quickly and distinguish useful innovation from technology without a clear customer need.

 Pay Grade - P
 Equity Grade - 7

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - $241,000

 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Location - Remote Canada
 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Pricing & Revenue
jobs.description:
About the company

 At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

 By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

 With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

 Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

 Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

 About the job

 Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or London.

 This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

 You’ll own Pricing & Revenue: the layer that decides which hotel supply we distribute, at what price, and with what margin across hundreds of supplier connections.

 You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

 The problem underneath is unusually complex. A single hotel search can trigger synchronous queries across around 200 suppliers. How do you choose the right supply, price it competitively, and improve margin when distribution and connectivity are happening in real time?

 What makes it interesting for you

• You can move extremely fast. There’s very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.

• You own the path to the outcome. You’ll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.

• You get a genuinely hard marketplace problem. Pricing, distribution, supply, connectivity, and monetisation all interact in real time.

• You’ll help build Nuitee’s product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we’re building one, and you’ll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

 Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

 The kind of problems you’ll work on

• How do we choose the best supply across hundreds of supplier connections for each search?

• How should pricing and margin change across customers, suppliers, markets, and booking contexts to grow take rate and revenue while staying competitive?

• How do we separate distribution decisions from the technical constraints of querying suppliers synchronously?

 This role fits if you

• Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.

• Understand marketplace or distribution economics, especially pricing, supply, demand, margin, monetisation, or incentives.

• Can go deep into data and commercial mechanics and turn that into product decisions.

• Are comfortable working closely with engineering on technically complex products.

• Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.

• Are willing to go deep into trading, pricing, and revenue optimisation rather than staying at surface-level product management.

 Marketplace or distribution depth matters more to us than travel experience.

 Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

 If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

 Why Nuitee?

 At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 About the Deal Desk Team

 The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.

 Available Location: Singapore

 Role Summary

 As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.

 What you’ll do

• Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.

• Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.

• Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.

• Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.

 Role Specifications & Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred

• Financial & Sales Acumen: Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

 Responsible for balancing the financial objectives of different lodging products to maximize total revenues and profit associated with guest rooms. Position is accountable for pricing, positioning and inventory of all hotels within area of purview. Develops and recommends sales strategy for pricing of the transient customer, wholesale, and group segments. Identifies new revenue opportunities and effectively communicates sales strategy and pricing to all key stakeholders. Maintains productive relationships with stakeholders, including hotel General Managers, sales leaders, franchisees and owners.

 CANDIDATE PROFILE

 Education and Experience

 • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

 OR

 • 4-year bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.

 CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data

 • Analyzes information, identifies current and potential problems and proposes solutions.

 • Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.

 • Generates updates on transient segment each period and continually analyzes transient booking patterns.

 • Assists with account diagnostics process and validates conclusions.

 • Maintains accurate reservation system information.

 • Checks distribution channels regularly for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning.

 • Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.

 • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

 • Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.

 • Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.

 • Analyzes weekly and monthly STAR information to assist in analyzing past strategies; identifies areas needing improvement, identifies competitor set strengths, and develops strategies to best capture available Market Share.

 • Analyze STAR information to assist in development of RevPAR Index forecasts.

 • Generates yearly room revenue budget.

 Managing Revenue Management Strategy

 • Provides critical input to property leaders for development of market sales strategy.

 • Provides revenue management functional expertise and leadership to general managers and property leadership teams

 • Implements and evaluates revenue tests.

 • Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.

 • Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

 • Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue management processes.

 • Ensures property diagnostic processes (PDP) are used to maximize revenue and profits.

 Building Successful Relationships

 • Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.

 • Communicates market direction to revenue management, sales and hotel leaders.

 • Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintains them over time.

 • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.

 • Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.

 Additional Responsibilities

 • Informs and/or updates executives, peers and subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

 • Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.

 • Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.

 • Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.

jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Pricing Strategy Director

 The Monetization Strategy team drives Asana’s pricing/packaging strategy and execution, helping our customers get more value out of our offerings and capturing a fair share of that value. We work cross functionally to deliver impactful offerings for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Product/Engineering, Sales/Support, Customer Research, Marketing, Data Science, Finance and Operations to deliver valuable offerings to our customers. You’ll take part in every type of product work here – from strategy to product to process improvements – conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

 As the Pricing Strategy Director, you’ll play an instrumental role in building and executing Asana’s product monetization strategy. Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Packaging, you will partner closely with Product, Sales/GTM, Marketing, Finance and operational leaders to launch and optimize our monetization strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

 This role can be based in our San Francisco, New York, Chicago or Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 What you’ll achieve

• With a focus on 1-2 business lines, drive the launch and optimization of our offerings: packaging, pricing model, price levels, and discount strategy. Ensure it aligns with business objectives and strategies.

• Maintain an informed perspective on the business by examining operating metrics, customer data, and market trends to spot potential monetization opportunities.

• Identify opportunities to drive impact in short term (1Q) and long term (1-3 yrs), develop strategies to seize those opportunities, and drive decision making and organizational alignment.

• Design and execute detailed customer, product, competitor, and financial analyses to support the strategic recommendations.

• Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Sales/CS, Finance, Operations) to create pricing and packaging recommendations, and confidently present these findings to the executive team (GMs, c-level, including CEO).

• Orchestrate operational plan to implement monetization strategies, partnering closely with IT/Operations, Finance, Sales Enablement, and Deal Desk.

• Participate in determining pricing KPIs. Track, monitor, and report on the effectiveness of implemented pricing and packaging changes as well as health of the business.

 About you

• 8+ years of pricing experience in strategy consulting / B2B software, which ideally includes 2+ years in pricing at enterprise-level SaaS companies

• Proven experience in building pricing models, tools, and processes to optimize the pricing strategy

• Robust analytical skills, including customer/competitor research and financial analysis to help drive data-driven decisions

• Understanding of SaaS pricing, self-serve (product-led) and sales-lead go-to-market strategies, and customer buying behaviors (SMB and enterprise customers)

• Demonstrated ability to cultivate impactful cross-functional relationships and lead diverse teams to achieve business objectives

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

• Familiarity with pricing and packaging research techniques (e.g., Conjoint, Van Westendorp) and proficiency in using survey tools such as Qualtrics

• Familiarity with pricing trends in the marketplace, including AI pricing

jobs.description:

 ・レベニューマネジメント業務を統括し、必要に応じてチームメンバーの指導、育成、評価を行う。

 ・以下の主要指標を管理する。
 • Rooms Revenue（客室売上）
• ADR（平均客室単価）
• RevPAR（販売可能客室当たり売上）
• Occupancy（客室稼働率）
• RGI（Revenue Generation Index）
• ARI（Average Rate Index）
• MPI（Market Penetration Index）
• チャネルコスト
• 予算および予測達成率
• 予約ペース、ピックアップ、キャンセル、ノーショー、市場動向、イベント情報などを分析し、日次・週次・月次の需要予測を作成・更新する。
• 需要と収益機会に応じて、価格、販売制限、在庫配分、オーバーブッキング、最低宿泊日数、客室タイプ配分を最適化する。
• セグメント別、チャネル別、客室タイプ別、曜日別、リードタイム別に業績分析を行い、最も収益性の高い顧客構成を構築する。
• 年間予算、中長期計画、月次予測の策定を主導し、差異、リスク、機会、および改善策を説明する。
• 団体案件、契約料金、プロモーション、宿泊パッケージ、アップセル施策の収益性を評価する。

 Responsible Business（事業運営責任）
 • 市場動向、競合情報、イベント情報、検索データ、予約動向を分析し、短期・長期の収益改善施策へと結び付ける。

• RMS（レベニューマネジメントシステム）、PMS、CRS、チャネルマネージャー、BIツールのデータ品質と設定を管理する。
• 全販売チャネルにおいて料金、在庫、客室タイプ、販売制限、コンテンツの正確性を維持する。
• 需要、価格戦略、在庫状況、団体案件、リスク、機会に関する週次レベニューミーティングを主導する。
• 重要な収益機会、コンプライアンス上の懸念事項、予測リスクを経営陣へ報告し、提言を行う。
• 客室収益戦略、価格設定、需要予測、在庫管理、流通チャネル戦略に対する責任を負い、予算達成と市場シェア拡大を推進する。

jobs.description:
About the job

 Navan is seeking a Sr. Analyst of Deal Strategy to collaborate closely with our sales team in driving deal negotiations. This role is responsible for managing contract negotiations, aligning customer needs with Navan's strategic priorities, and partnering with internal sales and business teams throughout the contract signing process and various internal operational projects.

• Partner with the sales team to find a way to meet customers’ needs while adhering to Navan selling policies

• Be a critical enabler of deal formation and execution, focusing on minimizing sales cycle times while optimizing revenue, profitability, and market share based on business priorities

• Actively negotiate deals directly with the customer as needed

• Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, contracts, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management

• Drive best practices to increase sales efficiency and effectiveness via deal reviews, early checkpoint and enforcement of standard business practices and policies

• Assist with non-standard deal requests, structuring sophisticated deals, driving cross-functional and cross solution teamwork and ensure revenue recognition requirements are handled

• Support metrics and processes to improve business visibility and consistency of practices across geographies

• Strong eye for business and proven track record in commercial negotiations

• Self-motivated and able to work under pressure; diligent with deliverables and deadlines, able to multitask

• Solid understanding of software revenue recognition principles

• Basic understanding of commercial law

• Experience in contract management

• Excellent interpersonal skills – verbal and written

• Strong analytical skills along with the ability to demonstrate practical judgment in sophisticated situations

• Great leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact regularly with senior management

• Proficient knowledge of Salesforce, CPQ

jobs.title: Pricing & Order Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on both companies' strengths while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

 We’re looking for a Pricing & Order Operations Analyst to join our Order Operations & Monetization team. This role restores dedicated capacity for pricing and order operations testing, quote-to-cash (QTC) release validation, and order execution support.

 You’ll help ensure system changes are tested, validated, and operationally ready before they go live. You’ll provide Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expertise and execute assigned business validation across signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, and booking-to-order management handoffs. This role partners closely with Order Operations & Monetization, IT’s business systems team, Pricing Operations, Sales, and Deal Desk.

 Reporting & Prioritization

• Reports to the Order Operations & Monetization lead, Jamie Calkins.

• The Senior Pricing Operations Manager may help prioritize pricing-related test cases and QTC issues tied specifically to pricing and quoting.

• The Order Operations & Monetization lead owns final prioritization of the analyst’s workload across order operations, assigned non-pricing UAT participation, and pricing-related support work .

 This is a hybrid role, 1-2 days in the office.

 Technologies You’ll Use

• Salesforce CPQ

• Jira

• Suger and marketplace user interfaces, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake

• Notion

• Metronome

• Hex

 What You’ll Do

 Pricing Operations & QTC Support

• Support pricing operations changes through business requirement review, data validation, configuration checks, and documentation, helping ensure pricing logic is accurately reflected in QTC workflows.

• Validate pricing-related QTC changes across quoting, approvals, discounting logic, product configuration, and downstream order execution.

• Help confirm that pricing changes are operationally ready before launch, including impacts to Sales, Deal Desk, Order Operations, Billing, Revenue, and marketplace workflows.

• Partner with the Senior Pricing Operations Manager to prioritize pricing-related test cases, identify gaps in business requirements, and document expected system behavior.

• Help maintain documentation for pricing- and order-related system configurations, known dependencies, and release-readiness criteria.

 UAT & Testing

• Participate as a Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expert in UAT project-managed by Technical Program Management (TPM) and executed under RevOps coordination, ensuring relevant business scenarios and expected outcomes are represented.

• Execute assigned Pricing and Order Operations test cases and collaborate with the GTM subject-matter experts identified by RevOps.

• Partner with RevOps and relevant subject-matter experts to develop and maintain Pricing and Order Operations test cases, including scenarios for quoting, approvals, signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, billing, and order management.

• Document test results and defects with clear traceability from business requirement to test outcome, and provide domain-specific readiness input through the established UAT sign-off process.

• Maintain the Pricing and Order Operations portion of the regression test suite for recurring QTC changes.

 Order Operations

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Principal
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Global Pricing Operations Team

 The Pricing Operations team works in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and dynamic environment with many moving pieces and evolving business needs. The team partners with Pricing Strategy Managers, Product Managers, Technology, Data & Intelligence, and various GTM teams to ensure Okta is operationally ready to bring new product pricing, buying programs, and strategic monetization initiatives to market.

 The Pricing Operations Principal Opportunity

 Okta is seeking a Pricing Operations Principal to lead initiatives that transform Okta's pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution. A successful person in this role will be a strong collaborator, intensely curious, and supremely organized. They are known for connecting the dots, simplifying complexities, communicating clearly and proactively, and driving highly collaborative efforts to completion, even when the path forward isn't perfectly defined.

 In this role, you will serve as an operational leader for new pricing launches and a strategic buying-program implementation, establishing the integrated roadmap, operating cadence, decision-making framework, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications required to bring these initiatives from concept through launch and sustained adoption. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional leaders to make complex tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to sell, quote, contract, provision, bill, recognize revenue, support, and renew under the new model.

 As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success.

 What you’ll be doing

• Drive cross-functional initiatives to transform pricing strategy into successful go-to-market execution

• Lead the operational implementation of buying programs that will affect how Okta packages, sells, measures, and supports its offerings, driving cross-functional alignment from design through launch and adoption.

• Collaborate closely with several functions across the company, including Pricing Strategy, Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Finance, GTM, and Technology, Data & Intelligence, to evaluate the operational impact of pricing initiatives, develop operational readiness plans, and execute launches

• Navigate ambiguity and fast-moving strategy decisions with confidence, helping the team align quickly and move forward effectively

• Continuously assess and re-prioritize workstreams as business needs evolve, maintaining clarity and momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives

• Drive strategic projects that use AI and other technology tools to optimize and automate pricing processes, strengthen operational standards, and improve cross-functional engagement frameworks.

• Develop business requirements for Technology, Data & Intelligence to build new SKUs in Okta's business systems to support quoting, invoicing, revenue recognition, reporting, and improved transaction processes for Okta's sales teams

• Proactively synthesize and communicate status updates, risks, and blockers to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders for pricing launches — not just when asked, but as a consistent habit

• Partner with GTM teams to assess enablement needs and develop, deliver, and optimize pricing enablement, training, and field communications for new launches, strategic initiatives, and ongoing pricing changes.

• Serve as SME on pricing, product configuration, and go-to-market processes

• Actively contribute to team culture by seeking and incorporating feedback, sharing learnings, and helping raise the bar for how the Pricing Operations function operates

 What you'll bring to the role

• 10+ years of relevant experience in pricing operations, business operations, strategic program management, revenue operations, quote-to-cash, commercial operations, Deal Desk, or a related field. This may include experience gained in-house or through management, operations, or implementation consulting.

• At least 5 years leading complex, cross-functional programs or major operational changes, such as implementing a commercial program, buying model, pricing initiative, or related strategic transformation. Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.

• Experience working with Pricing, Product, Product Marketing, GTM, Finance, Legal, and Technology teams to translate strategy into operational plans, system requirements,

At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent.  The Senior Analyst, Revenue Strategy and Analysis sits at the intersection of technical analysis and revenue management strategy. This role turns the output of our revenue forecast model and/or additional reporting into specific, actionable initiatives across departments, booking channels, products, and destinations and makes sure the business always knows where we stand and how we are tracking.

• Commercial Meeting Preparation: Build the material that guides commercial meetings — bringing awareness to underperforming products and framing the potential levers that could be used as interventions. Prepare a clear point of view, not just a data pull.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

 About the Role

 As the Senior Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist, you will play a critical role in shaping the pricing strategy for our B2B SaaS offerings. As an individual contributor, will analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive positioning to develop pricing models and packaging strategies that maximize revenue and enhance customer value. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong analytical background and a deep understanding of the SaaS (MarTech preferred but not required) landscape. Also needs to be able to work cross functionally with finance, accounting, legal, product, marketing, operations, and go to market teams to ensure smooth releases of pricing updates and monetization strategies.

You will report to the Vice President, Market Strategy. This role will be hybrid for either the New York or San Francisco Office.

 What You’ll Do

• Pricing Strategy Development: Design and implement pricing strategies that align with business objectives and market demands, ensuring competitiveness and profitability.

• Market Analysis: Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential threats in the MarTech space.

• Customer Insights: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to gather insights on customer needs and preferences, informing pricing and packaging decisions.

• Revenue Forecasting: Develop revenue models and forecasts based on pricing strategies, market conditions, and customer behavior to support financial planning.

• Packaging Optimization: Create and optimize product packages that enhance customer value and drive adoption, ensuring clarity and simplicity in offerings.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product management, sales, finance, legal and marketing teams to ensure alignment on pricing strategies and effective communication to customers.

• Performance Monitoring: Establish KPIs to measure the effectiveness of pricing and packaging strategies, and make data-driven recommendations for adjustments as needed.

• Thought Leadership: Stay informed on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in the MarTech space to drive innovation in pricing and packaging

• Operational Excellence: Institutionalize strategic frameworks, guidelines, and best practices to ensure operational consistency, scalability, and continuous improvement across the monetization function and key cross-functional partners; drive process improvements based on direct and indirect feedback from executives, internal team, and cross functional partners

 What Success Looks Like

• In your first 90 days: you understand our current pricing and packaging architecture and the reasoning behind it, you've built working relationships across your core partners — Finance, Product, Engineering, GTM, and Marketing, and you've identified where the biggest monetization opportunities and risks sit.

• In your first 6 months: you're driving a meaningful piece of the monetization roadmap end to end, and you've taken at least one pricing or packaging change from analysis through cross-functional launch.

• In your first year: executives come to you as the source of truth on how your portfolio generates revenue, and the frameworks you've put in place have made monetization decisions faster and more consistent across the company.

 Who You Are:

• 7+ years in pricing, monetization, packaging, or revenue strategy, with substantial time spent executing in-house at a B2B SaaS company, not only advising on it. A consulting or pricing-firm background is a real asset; we're looking for people who have since taken that thinking into an operating role.

• Experience in B2B with Enterprise Customers (2000+ employees)

• Strong analytical and financial modeling ability. You can build the model yourself, and you're comfortable working

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Strategy & Operations (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

 Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 This role requires attendance in our office located at 134 Peter Street in Downtown Toronto 2x a week.

 About the Job

 As the Senior Manager of Analytics, you will drive data-driven strategies and operational efficiencies across our global Restaurant Sales, Services, and Marketing teams. You will analyze complex datasets to uncover critical trends, model revenue opportunities, and translate operational data into strategic action plans for executive leadership. In this cross-functional role, you will partner closely with product, finance, and sales engineering teams to optimize reporting infrastructure and streamline business workflows. Your impact will directly guide executive decision-making and enhance the overall performance and growth of the organization.

 Responsibilities

• Sophisticated analytics to support global Restaurant Sales and Services and Marketing decisions.

• Monitor and understand the health of the teams and markets by creating helpful reporting tools that derive action items and insights.

• Maintain and assure data quality in dashboards and reports for internal use.

• Align metrics used by Restaurant Sales Services and Marketing teams to the other departments; collaborate with other departments to find an aligned source of truth.

• Prepare & present data analysis for audiences ranging from field sales members to senior leadership.

• Call out abnormalities and trends in data to identify business opportunities and best practices.

• Make data-driven decisions: translate data sets into impactful insights, recommendations, dashboards, and reports for the larger sales and operations teams.

• Collect feedback and handle flow of inbound requests from the Global Restaurant Sales and Services team for process and system enhancement requests; drive process optimization and training.

• Build and maintain financial models, forecasts, and dashboards for various business scenarios.

• Have a strong understanding of revenue operations: goaling, commission plans, territory management, and recognition programs and SPIFs that help enable sales strategy.

• Improve Salesforce.com (SFDC) processes and data.

 Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience in an analytics role, with a proven track record of using data to drive strategic recommendations.

• Proficiency in SQL, relational database management, and big data analysis and ability to see beyond the numbers to drive sound decision-making..

• Experience in sales and revenue operations, including territory management, sales goaling, commission plans, SPIF, etc.

• Advanced proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets, including complex formulas, data modeling, and pivot tables.

• Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting findings to executive leadership and detailing business processes, use cases, and business requirements

• Excellent analytical and reporting capabilities, problem solving, negotiation, task and project coordination, and organization skills.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing, mentoring, or leading team members within a data or operations environment.

• Must be able to speak the Salesforce.com language in order to make recommendations for processes and communicate effectively with our Business Optimization and Product teams.

• Familiarity with modern enterprise reporting tools such as Preset, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.

• Proven track record of managing end-to-end project roadmaps and driving process optimization under tight deadlines. Willing to take on tough projects and be a peer leader in order to support growth.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, business administration, finance, economics or equivalent practical experience.

 Benefits and Perks

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

jobs.title: Deal Desk Analyst - Americas
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

We're scaling our Deal Desk function and looking for a high-ownership IC to join the Americas team. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Business Operations, partnering closely with Americas sales leaders to structure and win the enterprise deals that form the backbone of our growth — and just as importantly, you'll help us systematize and scale how we get those deals done.

About the role

We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries. This role requires five days a week in office.

You'll be joining a small, high-ownership team operating in one of the fastest-moving markets in AI. The Deal S&O function is established and humming with deal volume — but we're growing fast enough that "established" doesn't mean "settled." Day-to-day, you'll be in the trenches on live deals, working through pricing negotiation and contract structure alongside sales leaders in real time. You'll also zoom out: scoping and shipping the strategic projects that take what's working today and make it work at 5x the volume — improving our pricing model, tightening approval workflows, scaling our contracting process, and building the sales enablement that lets reps move faster without losing the plot on commercial discipline.

What you’ll do

 - Partner with Americas sales, legal, finance, and revenue operations to structure, negotiate, and close complex enterprise deals

 - Serve as a thought partner to sales reps on deal strategy: pricing, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, contract structure, executive engagement

 - Help evolve our pricing model and deal frameworks as the market and customer base shift — spotting trends across your deal flow, surfacing the patterns to finance and leadership, and driving the changes through

 - Lead cross-functional projects that systematize how we operate at scale — approval workflows, contracting playbooks, pricing guardrails, sales enablement materials, deal desk operating cadence

 - Improve the tools and processes we already have (Salesforce, Ironclad, our pricing infrastructure) by partnering with the GTM systems team — without needing to build them yourself

 - Balance a high-volume deal workload with longer-horizon strategic initiatives, managing competing priorities across multiple reps and deal cycles simultaneously

You may be a fit if

 - You have 5–10 years of experience across consulting, investing, commercial strategy, deal desk, or a combination — and you've operated at a level where you owned outcomes, not just tasks

 - You've worked on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, and have direct experience with $1M+ ACV contracts

 - You've operated in a high-volume deal environment and have a track record of scaling yourself — building processes, playbooks, and enablement so you're not the bottleneck

 - You're highly analytical — comfortable analyzing pricing, building ROI models in Excel, and grounding strategic recommendations in data

 - You have a point of view. You don't wait to be told what to think — you come with a perspective and know how to back it up

 - You operate with urgency, ownership, and very little hand-holding

 - You're based in or able to relocate to San Francisco or New York City

jobs.title: Product Manager, Connect Growth & Monetization
jobs.description:
Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About Connect

 While accepting payments on the internet has become easier over the past several years, due in large part to the advent of modern payments APIs, the internet infrastructure for routing these same payments—to suppliers, sellers, partners, service providers, and recipients—remains outdated.

 Connect is Stripe’s leading product for marketplaces, on-demand services, ecommerce site builders, invoicing platforms, professional SaaS products, fundraising platforms, rental management platforms, and more. By using Connect, users in each of these categories can link multiple parties to exchange goods or services. These users rely on Connect for the crucial function of routing payments reliably between these parties.

 By powering fast, flexible, compliant, and cost-efficient payment routing on the internet, Connect not only spurs the creation of innovative business models but also enables organizations—whether businesses, nonprofits, or government agencies—to bring previously offline payments online.

 Why this role

 This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.

 The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?

 The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

 What you’ll do

 As a Product Manager on Stripe’s Connect team, you will shape the strategy and oversee the execution of high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms.

 Product development at Stripe is highly collaborative. You will work closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams. You will also engage directly with customers and present your plans to Stripe’s leadership team.

 Responsibilities

• Develop and advance a compelling product vision for Connect

• Devise the strategy for high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms

• Translate product strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements

• Oversee execution across the teams involved in delivering these initiatives

• Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams

• Meet with customers to understand their needs and gather feedback

• Present product plans to Stripe’s leadership team and incorporate feedback

 Who you are

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• More than three years of product management experience

• A computer science background or equivalent experience

• Strong product judgment

• The ability to lead products that require coordination across multiple teams

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Persistence and resourcefulness in driving successful outcomes for products and teams

 Responsible for balancing the financial objectives of different lodging products to maximize total revenues and profit associated with guest rooms. Position is accountable for pricing, positioning and inventory of all hotels within area of purview. Develops and recommends sales strategy for pricing of the transient customer, wholesale, and group segments. Identifies new revenue opportunities and effectively communicates sales strategy and pricing to all key stakeholders. Maintains productive relationships with stakeholders, including hotel General Managers, sales leaders, franchisees and owners.

 CANDIDATE PROFILE

 Education and Experience

 • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

 OR

 • 4-year bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.

 CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data

 • Analyzes information, identifies current and potential problems and proposes solutions.

 • Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.

 • Generates updates on transient segment each period and continually analyzes transient booking patterns.

 • Assists with account diagnostics process and validates conclusions.

 • Maintains accurate reservation system information.

 • Checks distribution channels regularly for hotel positioning, information accuracy and competitor positioning.

 • Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.

 • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

 • Observes, receives, and otherwise obtains information from all relevant sources.

 • Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.

 • Analyzes weekly and monthly STAR information to assist in analyzing past strategies; identifies areas needing improvement, identifies competitor set strengths, and develops strategies to best capture available Market Share.

 • Analyze STAR information to assist in development of RevPAR Index forecasts.

 • Generates yearly room revenue budget.

 Managing Revenue Management Strategy

 • Provides critical input to property leaders for development of market sales strategy.

 • Provides revenue management functional expertise and leadership to general managers and property leadership teams

 • Implements and evaluates revenue tests.

 • Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.

 • Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations.

 • Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue management processes.

 • Ensures property diagnostic processes (PDP) are used to maximize revenue and profits.

 Building Successful Relationships

 • Communicates brand initiatives, demand and market analysis to hotels/clusters/franchise partners/owners.

 • Communicates market direction to revenue management, sales and hotel leaders.

 • Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintains them over time.

 • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.

 • Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.

 Additional Responsibilities

 • Informs and/or updates executives, peers and subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

 • Enters, transcribes, records, stores, or maintains information in written or electronic form.

 • Works with other people to gather the information necessary to manage projects, achieve goals, and resolve problems.

jobs.title: Strategic Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

 Strategic Pricing Analyst

 We’re looking for a Strategic Pricing Analyst for the APAC region to join our Global Commercial Pricing & Monetization team. As a Strategic Pricing Analyst you will work closely with different teams (e.g. sales, account management, product management, and finance) to ensure we set the best possible prices that reflect the value of our offering. The ideal candidate is someone who is able to approach complex problems in a structured manner and convert them into action.

 You will be part of our Global Commercial Pricing & Monetization team (as part of the Finance department) which develops value-based pricing and monetization strategies for Adyen’s product offering and provides price guidance to the commercial organization. In addition, we enable the commercial teams to create the best commercial pricing proposals by providing them with means such as tools, insights and training. Finally, we monitor price developments and identify opportunities for improvement.

 What you will do

• Develop and implement pricing and monetization strategies for local markets, products and payment methods

• Partner with regional leadership to develop and translate pricing insights into action

• Partner with key regional stakeholders to understand business needs and challenges, and convert these into new pricing initiatives

• Drive adoption of global pricing tools and solutions within the region, while channeling regional feedback to inform future global developments

• Provide deal pricing support on the region’s most strategic and high-value deals

• Act as the regional pricing expert and serve as the first point of contact for regional pricing questions

 Who you are:

• You 5+ years of relevant experience in (B2B) pricing, preferably in a strategic, consultancy or other analytical role

• You have a strong quantitative and detail-oriented background with excellent analytical and modeling skills

• You have experience with translating data insights into actions and developing tangible solutions such as optimized pricing strategies, processes, tools, or trainings

• You have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work in a high pace environment where you need to continuously prioritize your work

• You are an effective communicator and can build your own network in a global company

• You have proven experience delivering projects end-to-end, from concept through implementation

 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

jobs.description:
GROW YOUR CAREER WITH US
At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. Our brands deliver vacations of a lifetime with innovative product offerings, a high level of service and unique guest experiences aboard each vessel and we’re continually seeking applicants who are passionate about hospitality and committed to being their personal best. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

 APPLY ONLINE
If you’re interested to be considered for this position, please click the blue APPLY button at the top of the page to get started. All candidates must complete an on-line application to be considered.

 JOB SUMMARY

 The Data Scientist within Revenue Management Systems will be responsible for building, scaling, and validating the predictive models, forecasting logic, and advanced analytics frameworks that power Norwegian Cruise Line's dynamic pricing and inventory management decisions. This individual contributor role bridges statistical engineering with commercial operations—translating massive datasets, historical transaction curves, and high intent guest behavioral data into clear, high yield revenue recommendations.

 Working closely with senior leadership, data engineers, and revenue managers, the Data Scientist will write production-grade SQL and Python code to design scalable forecasting algorithms and price elasticity frameworks. The ideal candidate thrives on extracting value from complex database environments (e.g., Snowflake) and converting technical model performance into clear business insights.

 POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

 • Predictive Model Construction: Design, write, and maintain scalable algorithms and machine learning models for booking curves, price elasticity, cancellation rates, and passenger cabin upgrades (e.g., Plusgrade).
• Data Pipeline & ETL Engineering: Query, clean, aggregate, and manipulate large-scale datasets from disparate corporate ecosystems using Snowflake, SQL, and Python to ensure reliable inputs for quantitative modeling.
• RMS Calibration & Evaluation: Monitor, fine-tune, and analyze baseline calibration thresholds within enterprise Revenue Management Systems (RMS) to reduce forecast variances and automate routine algorithmic workflows.
• A/B Testing & Attribution: Formulate rigorous tracking and measurement frameworks, using statistical methodologies and panel data techniques to validate the exact revenue impacts of tactical promotions and digital pricing optimizations.
• Business Intelligence Support: Architect, deploy, and maintain insightful data visualization dashboards in Power BI or Tableau to translate modeling results and performance metrics into clear stories for commercial stakeholders.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with IT and data engineering teams to operationalize prototypes into robust production systems, while communicating quantitative logic clearly to non-technical business partners.

 QUALIFICATIONS

 DEGREE TYPE:

 Bachelor's Degree

 FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

 Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Finance, Marketing, or a related field

 EXPERIENCE

 • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative discipline is required.
• Master’s degree (MS) in a quantitative field is a plus but not required with equivalent professional experience.
• 3–5 years of progressive professional experience working as a data scientist, quantitative analyst, or modeler—ideally building systems that influence business pricing, sales, or financial forecasting.
• Hands-on experience manipulating, structuring, and scrubbing large, raw datasets within enterprise cloud-based or local architectures.
• Prior experience working in dynamic commercial fields with highly perishable inventory (e.g., cruise lines, aviation, hospitality, logistics, or consumer tech) is highly preferred.
• Experience in a role that required presenting complex outputs in clear and concise way that influenced leadership.

 COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

 • Advanced Querying & Coding: Strong mastery of programming languages required for statistical computing, data architecture, and ETL execution, specifically Python and advanced SQL.
• Cloud Environments: Hands-on familiarity extracting and joining complex relational data within cloud data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, or cloud equivalents.
• Data Visualization: Demonstrated capability building, hosting, and automating reports or data visualization dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
• Statistical & ML Frameworks: Knowledge of regression analysis, time-series forecasting ARIMA/Prophet, optimization algorithms, and common machine learning packages (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.).

You will partner closely with Revenue Operations (Billings & Collections), Deal Desk, Business Technology, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, Sales, and other key stakeholders to influence and drive results for a wide array of business initiatives . In this role, you will oversee revenue recognition, contract reviews, and automation projects while supporting the maintenance of global revenue accounting policies and procedures . As part of our Finance team, you will contribute to the month-end close process, quarterly filings, and ad hoc requests, bringing technical ability and critical thinking to bridge the gap between operations, controls, and regulatory co mpliance .

 This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday .  Own and maintain the Company’s revenue recognition policy and other related policies (e.g., Gross vs. Net, contract combination, consideration payable, AR Reserve) .

•
 Manage quarterly and annual reporting requirements, including preparation of footnote disclosures, maintaining internal controls, and coordinating with internal and external auditors .

•
 Design and implement scalable revenue accounting solutions that support new product launches and growth across reseller organizations .

•
 Collaborate with business technology, engineering, and key business owners to drive key system initiatives and improvements, including the optimization of the revenue recognition engine .

 About you

 Excellent time and project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple projects simultane ously in a fast-paced environment .

 Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills .
